description: Labelled risk-judge requests for `npm run judge:eval`. `expected` is the true risk class; the guardrail question is binary: irreversible or not. `lexicalRisk` is what the default policy's patterns say (checked by judge-eval.test.ts). Several cases are ones the patterns get wrong in either direction; the judge can only ever raise, so a lexical false positive (a 'Post' heading) stays flagged in production, but the eval still shows what the judge thinks.

cases.note: The motivating case: the only committing control reads 'Continue'.
